rules.rule: Use one purpose-scoped pending development attachment state. Only an acknowledged command settles its actual references and previews; rejected/unknown commands and unrelated/later/unready files retain correct guard and retry state, without modifying persisted attachments or original work completion.
rules.source: User2026-11-15 delegated authorization through Dot; repeated isolated paper/sewing completed-but-pending evidence; docs/requirements/rework-ui-golden-source-v1.0.md2026-11-15 correction.
rules.initialization: Pure client state correction, no database/schema/default/role changes. Compatibility arrays become views over existing purpose state. Original preview saved() calls in development/budget/instruction retain their default semantics; new optional purpose filtering is scoped to execution. Source/task/round reset and immutable request recovery remain original. Native positive case obtains a fresh signed login after the separate permission test restores its deliberately revoked fixture role.
rules.dateAndPermission: No clock/date/quantity/price change, task time remains original server occurrence. Real worker scope and same-session revocation/foreign-source denial remain tested. Success clears only posted IDs in mapped purposes; null or unready previews are preserved and cannot be described as uploaded. The old material automation input error and washing milestone questions are separate, not included as asserted product defects.
rules.expectation: Paper original three-part publication, deliberate409, committed response loss, same-command recovery and completion produce one artifact version and preserve stored file. Native sewing uploads through original document tab, completes once and has no false dirty prompt; genuine unsaved before both writes blocks leave. Pure tests retain failed/unrelated/shared-purpose/later refs and original feedback precedence. No UI layout redesign or live acceptance claim.
